title: He Laughed at the Taser But Didn’t See the Pepper Spray Coming
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On June 30, 2024, police were called to a residence where a man was refusing to leave in La Crosse, WI. He was reportedly damaging property and possibly experiencing a mental crisis. Despite the officer's numerous attempts to get him to leave peacefully, he stayed put. Several taser cycles were deployed which had minimal impact, but a little bit of pepper spray eventually did the trick.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
